_schema.note: BlackVault's voice. Menacing but dry — a crew that does this for a living and finds the defender's effort mildly interesting. Never comic, never cackling, never an exclamation mark.

fields.climaxHoldsBackups: stage five opener when the backups are already lost
fields.climaxNoBackups: stage five opener when the backups are still standing
fields.openers: shown as the attack begins, once per run
fields.ticker: attract-screen threat feed. Real technique names only.

name: BlackVault
openers: We have been inside for eleven days. Today is just the part you can see.
Your estate took four minutes to map. Nobody was looking.
We do not need to be fast. We need you to be slower.
taunt: Thank you. That was the door we wanted.
You reached for the wrong layer. We counted on it.
Noted. That control was not configured to stop us.
You are responding. We are already past you.
That is the third time you have protected the wrong thing.
slowed: You cost us minutes. We have hours.
Half a control is a control we work around.
You found it. You did not finish it.
foiled: That was configured before we arrived. Inconvenient.
Layered. We will find a client who is not.
You closed it before we used it. Rare.
That was not luck. Someone made a decision months ago.
climaxHoldsBackups: We took your recovery two stages ago. This part is administrative.
There is nothing to restore from. Read the note.
climaxNoBackups: Your backups are still there. That is the only reason this is a conversation.
You kept the one thing we came for. We will still make today expensive.
